demoBanner: Admin demo — all actions are simulated. Approve/reject buttons update local state only.

ratingLegend.title: Trimmed mean
ratingLegend.description: Top & bottom 10% of ratings removed before averaging — prevents coordinated 1-star bombing or fake 5-stars.

ratingLegend.title: 24-hr fix-it window
ratingLegend.description: Provider can re-submit photos or dispute a rating within 24 hours before it locks into the trimmed mean.

ratingLegend.title: 3.0★ floor
ratingLegend.description: Providers whose trimmed mean drops below 3.0 are auto-suspended pending admin review and payout hold.
